(LXX for מֵעַתָּה), [[r:LUK.1.48|Luk 1:48]], [[r:ACT.18.6|Act 18:6]], al.; ἄχρι τοῦ ν., [[r:ROM.8.22|Rom 8:22]], [[r:PHP.1.5|Php 1:5]]; ἕως τοῦ ν. (LXX for עַד עַתָּה), [[r:MAT.24.21|Mat 24:21]], [[r:MRK.13.19|Mrk 13:19]]; τὰ ν., as regards the present, [[r:ACT.5.38|Act 5:38]]; with pret., just now, but now, [[r:MAT.26.65|Mat 26:65]], [[r:JHN.11.8|Jhn 11:8 21:10]]; with fut., now, presently, [[r:JHN.12.31|Jhn 12:31]], [[r:ACT.20.22|Act 20:22]]; so with praes., presently, forthwith, [[r:JHN.12.31|Jhn 12:31 17:13]]; καὶ ν., [[r:JHN.11.22|Jhn 11:22 17:5]], al.; ἀλλὰ ν., [[r:LUK.22.36|Luk 22:36]]; ἔτι ν., [[r:1CO.3.2|1Co 3:2]]; τότε (πότε)... ν. (δέ), [[r:ROM.6.21|Rom 6:21 11:30]]; ν. ἤδη, [[r:1JN.4.3|1Jn 4:3]]; ν. οὖν, [[r:ACT.10.33|Act 10:33]], al.

Of logical sequence (often difficult to disting. from the temporal sense; cf. (of the time within which something happens; M, Pr., 73; B1., § 36, 13), νυκτός, by night, [[r:MAT.2.14|Mat 2:14]], [[r:JHN.3.2|Jhn 3:2]], [[r:1TH.5.7|1Th 5:7]], al.; ν. κ. ἡμέρας, [[r:MRK.5.5|Mrk 5:5]], [[r:1TH.2.9|1Th 2:9]], al.; ἡμέρας κ. ν., [[r:LUK.18.7|Luk 18:7]], [[r:REV.4.8|Rev 4:8]], al.; μέσης ν., [[r:MAT.25.6|Mat 25:6]]; dative, νυκτί, in ans. to the question, "when?" with genitive of thing(s), strange to, estranged from, ignorant of: [[r:EPH.2.12|Eph 2:12]]; (with) strange, unusual: [[r:1PE.4.12|1Pe 4:12.]] As subst., ὁ ξ.,

In NT, a pitcher of wood or stone : [[r:MRK.7.4|Mrk 7:4.]]† (AS)

[[r:3KI.13.4|3Ki 13:4]]) [[r:MRK.9.18|Mrk 9:18]].† (AS)

G3588.strongs: the (sometimes to be supplied, at others omitted, in English idiom)
G3588.kjv: the, this, that, one, he, she, it, etc
senses: the prepositive article (ἄρθρον προτακτικόν), originally a demonstr. pron. (so usually in Hom.), in general corresponding to the Eng. definite article.
I
As demonstr. pron.
As frequently in Hom., absol., he (she, it), his (etc.): [[r:ACT.17.28|Act 17:28]] (quoted from the poet Aratus).

Distributive, ὁ μὲν... ὁ δέ, the one... the other: [[r:1CO.7.7|1Co 7:7]], [[r:GAL.4.22|Gal 4:22]]; pl., [[r:ACT.14.4|Act 14:4, 17:32]], [[r:PHP.1.16|Php 1:16]], al.; οἱ μὲν... ἄλλοι δέ, [[r:MAT.16.14|Mat 16:14]], [[r:JHN.7.12|Jhn 7:12]]; οἱ μεν̀... ὁδέ, [[r:HEB.7.21|Heb 7:21, 23]].
In narration (without ὁ μὲν preceding), ὁ δέ, but he: [[r:MAT.2.14|Mat 2:14]], [[r:MRK.1.45|Mrk 1:45]], [[r:LUK.8.21|Luk 8:21]], [[r:JHN.9.38|Jhn 9:38]], al. mult.
II
As prepositive article, the, prefixed,

to nouns unmodified: ὁ θεός, τὸ φῶς, etc.; to abstract nouns, ἡ σοφία, etc., to pl. nouns which indicate a class, οἱ ἀλώπεκες, foxes, [[r:MAT.8.20|Mat 8:20]], al.; to an individual as representing a class, ὁ ἐργάτης, [[r:LUK.10.7|Luk 10:7]]; with nom. = voc. in addresses, [[r:MAT.11.26|Mat 11:26]], [[r:JHN.19.3|Jhn 19:3]], [[r:JAS.5.1|Jas 5:1]], al.; to things which pertain to one, ἡ χεῖρ, his hand, [[r:MRK.3.1|Mrk 3:1]]; to names of persons well known or already mentioned; usually to names of countries (originally adjectives), ἡ Ἰουδαία, etc.

To modified nouns: with of person(s) pron. genitive, μοῦ, σοῦ, etc.; with poss. pron., ἐμός, σός, etc.; with adj. between the art. and the noun, ὁ ἀγαθὸς ἄνθρωπος, [[r:MAT.12.35|Mat 12:35]]; the noun foll, by adj., both with art., ὁ ποιμὴν ὁ καλός, [[r:JHN.10.11|Jhn 10:11]] (on ὁ ὄχλος πολύς, [[r:JHN.12.9|Jhn 12:9]], see M, Pr., 84); before adjectival phrases, ἡ κατ᾽ ἐκλογὴν πρόθεσις, [[r:ROM.9.11|Rom 9:11.]]
To Other parts of speech used as substantives;
neuter adjectives: τ. ἀγαθόν, etc.;
cardinal numerals: ὁ εἶς, οἷ δύο, etc.; (with) participles: ὁ βαπτίζων (= ὁ Βαπτιστής, [[r:MAT.14.2|Mat 14:2]]), [[r:MRK.6.14|Mrk 6:14]]; πᾶς ὁ, with ptcp., every one who, etc.;
adverbs: τὸ πέραν, τὰ νῦν, ὁ ἔσω ἄνθρωπος;

infinitives: nom., τὸ θέλειν, [[r:ROM.7.18|Rom 7:18]], al.; genitive, τοῦ, after adjectives, ἄξιον τοῦ πορεύεσθαι, [[r:1CO.16.4|1Co 16:4]]; verbs, ἐλαχεν τοῦ θυμιᾶσαι, [[r:LUK.1.9|Luk 1:9]]; and frequently in a final sense, ἐξῆλθεν ὁ σπείρειν, [[r:MAT.13.3|Mat 13:3]] (on the artic. inf., see Bl., §71).
In the neut. to sentences, phrases or single words treated as a quotation: τὸ Ἐι δύνῃ, [[r:MRK.9.23|Mrk 9:23]]; τὸ ἔτι ἅπαξ, [[r:HEB.12.27|Heb 12:27]]; τὸ ἀνέβη, [[r:EPH.4.9|Eph 4:9]], al.

To prepositional phrases: οἱ ἀπὸ Ἰταλίας, [[r:HEB.13.24|Heb 13:24]]; οἱ ἐκ νόμου, [[r:ROM.4.14|Rom 4:14]]; neut. accusative absol., in adverbial phrases, τὸ καθ᾽ ἡμέραν, daily, [[r:LUK.11.3|Luk 11:3]]; τὸ κατὰ σάρκα, as regards the flesh, [[r:ROM.9.5|Rom 9:5.]]

To nouns in the genitive, denoting kinship, association, etc.: ὁ τοῦ, the son of (unless context indicates a different relationship), [[r:MAT.10.2|Mat 10:2]], al.; τὰ τοῦ θεοῦ, the things that pertain to God, [[r:MAT.16.23|Mat 16:23]]; τὰ τῆς εἰρήνης, [[r:ROM.14.19|Rom 14:19]] (cf. M, Pr., 81ff.; Bl, §§46, 47). (AS)
eighty , Lat. octoginta, (Thucydides), etc.:—;ionic and doric ὀγδώκοντα, (Iliad by Homer) (ML)

the eighth. [[r:LUK.1.59|Luk 1:59]], [[r:ACT.7.3|Act 7:3]]" (LXX), [[r:REV.17.11|Rev 17:11 21:20]]; one of eight, with seven others (usually, in this sense, with αὐτός added, but cf. Plat., Legg., iii, 695 with; Plut., Pelop., 13; [[r:2MA.5.27|2Ma 5:27]]): [[r:2PE.2.5|2Pe 2:5]].† (AS)

senses: bulk, mass; metaphorically, an encumbrance: [[r:HEB.12.1|Heb 12:1.]]† SYN.: βάρος, a weight; φορτίον, a burden, that which is borne (AS)

(ὁδός), to travel, journey: [[r:LUK.10.33|Luk 10:33]] (cf.δι-, συν-οδεύω).† (AS)

senses: (ὁδηγός) to lead on one's way, to guide: with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.15.14|Mat 15:14]], [[r:LUK.6.39|Luk 6:39]]; id. before ἐπί, [[r:REV.7.17|Rev 7:17.]] Metaphorical, to guide, instruct, teach: [[r:ACT.8.31|Act 8:31]]; before εἰς τ. ἀλήθειαν (ἐν τ. ἀ., WH, mg.), [[r:JHN.16.13|Jhn 16:13]] (cf. [[r:PSA.25.5|Psa 25:5]]).† (AS)

senses: (ὁδοιπόρος, a traveller, [[r:GEN.37.25|Gen 37:25]], al.), to travel, journey: [[r:ACT.10.9|Act 10:9.]]† (AS)
(see supr.), a journey. [[r:JHN.4.6|Jhn 4:6]], [[r:2CO.11.26|2Co 11:26]].† (AS)

G3598.strongs: a road; by implication, a progress (the route, act or distance); figuratively, a mode or means
senses: a way, path, road: [[r:MAT.2.12|Mat 2:12]], [[r:MRK.10.46|Mrk 10:46]], [[r:LUK.3.5|Luk 3:5]] al.; κατὰ τὴν ὁ., [[r:LUK.10.4|Luk 10:4]], al.; παρὰ τὴν ὁ., [[r:MAT.13.4|Mat 13:4]], al.; with genitive of person(s), (subj.), τὴν ὁ. ἑτοιμάζειν (fig.), [[r:MAT.3.3|Mat 3:3]], [[r:MRK.1.3|Mrk 1:3]], al.; with genitive term. (obj.), ἐθνῶν, [[r:MAT.10.5|Mat 10:5]]; τ. ἁγίων (figuratively), [[r:HEB.9.8|Heb 9:8]]; accusative, ὁδόν, with force of prep. (like Heb. דֶּרֶךְ; Bl., §34, 8; 35, 5), ὁ. θαλάσσης, [[r:MAT.4.15|Mat 4:15]] (LXX).

A traveller's way, journey: ἐν τ. ὁ., [[r:MAT.5.25|Mat 5:25]], [[r:MRK.8.27|Mrk 8:27]], al.; ἐξ ὁ., [[r:LUK.11.6|Luk 11:6]]; εἰς ὁ., [[r:MAT.10.10|Mat 10:10]]; τ. ὁδὸν πορεύεσθαι, [[r:ACT.8.39|Act 8:39]]; ὁ. ἡμέρας, [[r:LUK.2.44|Luk 2:44]]; ὁδὸν ποιεῖν (= cl., ὁ. ποιεῖσθαι; V. Field, Notes, 25), to make one's way, i.e. proceed on one's journey, [[r:MRK.2.23|Mrk 2:23.]]

Metaphorical (cl.; but esp. frequently in Heb.; see Cremer, 442ff.), of a course of conduct, a way of thinking or acting: [[r:ACT.14.16|Act 14:16]], [[r:1CO.4.17|1Co 4:17 12:31]], [[r:JAS.1.8|Jas 1:8 5:20]]; τοῦ Κάϊν, Ju 11; τ.
